_comment: Edit 'status' to 'Tested' when verified in-game. Edit 'name' to rename a group. Add cards to 'cards' array to reassign them. 'confidence'/'evidence' regenerated by /feature-map as of v1.10.16 (2026-09-01) - see .audit/feature-map.md for full citations.

groups.name: Wild Mushroom Foraging
groups.evidence: Features.json T1.5/T2.21 pass 2026-07-21, but 1.10.16 (2026-08-26) fixed a real isClearing double-count bug in the shared forage injector affecting these species - material change since pass, unverified since

groups.name: Truffle Chain
groups.evidence: No dedicated playtest item; TruffleFatCookPatch (old 0.25s poll) retired in favor of the same proven declarative Cook-stat pattern used by all mushrooms (CHANGELOG confirms removal)

groups.name: Foraged Berries
groups.evidence: T1.5 pass 2026-07-21 explicitly names this group, but Redcurrant is one of the species affected by the 1.10.16 (2026-08-26) isClearing double-count fix - material change since pass

groups.name: Medicinal Herbs
groups.evidence: T1.5 (2026-07-21) + T2.73 (2026-08-15, hot-water fail-message) both PASS, but Wild Flowers/Dandelion/Common Plantain/Chamomile/Yarrow are named in the 1.10.16 (2026-08-26) isClearing double-count fix - material change since pass

groups.name: Peanut Cultivation and Products
groups.evidence: New group added 2026-09-01 (previously untracked - absent from prior Features.json and ModInfo.json Description, though README documents it fully); no dedicated playtest item; declarative CI/DA/BP chain identical in shape to proven Truffle/Hemp chains; files stable since 2026-06-23/2026-07-16

groups.name: Mushroom Log Cultivation
groups.evidence: T2.20 pass 2026-07-21; fresh JSON re-check confirms working Progress-stat maturation timer on all 6 species (corrects the stale v1.8.0 feature-map's 'CRITICAL - no timer' finding)

groups.name: Hemp Farming and Products
groups.evidence: T2.20 (2026-07-21) VERIFIED cultivation/harvest; Hemp Butter dead-end FIXED 1.10.17 (2026-09-01): Active's Wetness started at 0 so its OnZero solidify-transform could never fire (engine requires a positive-to-zero crossing); now starts full at retuned max 96 - in-game verify pending, see feature-map.md B10 resolution

groups.name: Drying System
groups.evidence: No explicit playtest citation (T2.21 'remaining groups' spot-check plausibly covers it); minor 2026-07-31 recipe-yield tweak (quantity only, not structural)

groups.name: Wooden Pantry
groups.evidence: No explicit playtest citation; simple proven Kit/Place/Dismantle pattern, file history stable

groups.name: Oil Press Station
groups.evidence: T2.18 pass 2026-07-21 explicitly names 'Oil Press Station'

groups.name: Herbal and Seed Oils
groups.evidence: T2.46 pass 2026-07-30 confirmed all 3 herbal oil variants appeared in the Oil Press recipe list; Hemp/Truffle/Peanut oils use the identical mechanism

groups.name: Pickling System
groups.evidence: Open CRITICAL C1 in .audit/mod-report.md and summary.md (dated 2026-09-01, current): DroppedOnDestroy uses the wrong flat JSON shape on 9 files (all 8 Ready/Sealed pickle vat variants plus OpenPickleJar.json, a 9th file not previously catalogued) - destroying/emptying silently returns nothing. Core build/ferment/eat loop was VERIFIED via T2.19 (2026-07-21); destroy-recovery sub-feature (T2.117/T2.118, PENDING 2026-08-22) remains unresolved

groups.name: Herb Pipe
groups.evidence: No explicit playtest citation; stable proven Load/Smoke/Empty declarative pattern

groups.name: Flower Garland
groups.evidence: No explicit playtest citation; simple proven pattern, purely decorative as designed

groups.name: Herbal Teas and Broth
groups.evidence: 4 of 10 liquids have working BPs verified via T2.18/T2.34 (2026-07-21)/T2.64 (2026-08-14); the other 6 remain a long-standing perk-spawn-only design gap (not flagged unreachable by acquisition-coverage audit, but not verified either)

groups.name: Medicinal Preparations
groups.evidence: No explicit playtest citation (T2.21 'remaining groups' plausibly covers it); proven BP+DA pattern, gates structurally sound

groups.name: Foraging Forest WorldMap
groups.evidence: Most heavily playtested feature in the mod: T1.34 (2026-08-14), T1.64 (2026-08-29, most recent), T2.1/T2.2/T3.1 (2026-07-21 sealablegates retro), T2.84 (2026-08-15 Misty Falls). Current MapNodes.json has 6 nodes (adds Highland Meadow + Misty Falls vs the stale v1.8.0 map's 4), matching ModInfo.json exactly

groups.name: Character Perks
groups.evidence: No dedicated playtest item for the group as a whole; all 15 files confirmed structurally sound (correct PerkGroup GUID, correct WarpType companions). Perk_ForestScout was removed in 1.10.15 - no longer part of this roster
